checkpoint_selection: highest mean deterministic development return; earliest step on ties; selection scenarios are not final tests
assessment_role: additional development diagnostics after checkpoint selection; cannot support final confirmatory claims
physical_model: unchanged frozen paper-v2 physics, CSI acquisition, router, reward and codebooks
rms_csi_scope: actor projection coordinates only; critic, payload and physical channels unchanged
separate_clip_scope: one actor parameter group and one critic parameter group; same Adam and objective
inference: greedy physical and communication categorical actions
final_policy: reserved final scenarios remain unopened during screening
